boundaries: encoded selection8 accepts exactly approved active peer7 and current local/peer certificate digests
selection9 refuses a plausible out-of-range public candidate
changed own or selected-peer digest refuses, including the final digest byte
inactive own or selected peer refuses
explicit revoked state2 and signed revocation flag1 each refuse
revocation of unrelated peer0 does not invalidate selected peer7
legacy first-slot and no-native-selection behavior preserved
limitations:
Emitted nativePeerCurrent checks over public prevalidated enrollment state.

This fixture supplies only active/revoked public enrollment records and frozen
certificate digests. It performs no certificate signature verification, grant
renewal, live transport, actor operation or expiry-clock simulation. The actual
peerValid predicate checks enrollment state and its signed revocation flag;
civil-time expiry is not a field in that predicate.
environment: x86-64 Linux; RV64 QEMU and AArch64 assembly emulator under qemu-aarch64. No physical ARM hardware or full transport qualification.
